context: Yuki-office and Asuka catch a small art exhibit on a Saturday afternoon.
purpose: Two female friends enjoying culture together casually.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: This exhibition has quite a reputation.
lines.style: Warm, encouraging opening. Even pace. Gestures gently toward the space around you. A teacher inviting someone to feel included in something good.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: うん、作品ごとに個性ある。
lines.en: Yeah—each piece has its own presence.
lines.style: Soft agreement. The pause before the dash is small, thoughtful. Turning to look at something specific. Genuinely engaged, not performing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: Art really does reach into you, doesn't it.
lines.style: Reflective, almost wondering out loud. Steady, unhurried. Sharing an observation rather than teaching one. A small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. Warm landing on the word 'came.' Not effusive—just honest gratitude, the kind that doesn't need much volume to land.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: お茶でもしましょうか。
lines.style: Inviting, natural pivot. Light suggestion, not a directive. The tone of someone who's comfortable with companionable quiet and wants to extend it.
